scope: synthetic offline Phase 0N held-out reliability comparison of the unchanged Phase 0M identity-aware non-destructive selective candidate and three frozen comparators on fresh seeds 161-180; no held-out tuning, paid API, formal scaling, or downstream LLM accuracy claim

prior_identity_contract.copied-global: legacy comparator: copy the global prior into every contextual domain state
prior_identity_contract.global-only: initialize the global state from the declared global prior and every contextual domain state cold
prior_identity_contract.contextual: initialize the global state globally and each contextual domain state from an explicit per-domain prior

candidate_action_contract.acceptable: deploy the candidate state only after all eight probe rounds per domain confirm acceptability
candidate_action_contract.harmful: reject deployment and route through a fresh cold fallback without mutating the candidate state
candidate_action_contract.ambiguous: abstain from deployment and route through a fresh cold fallback without mutating the candidate state
candidate_action_contract.early_acceptable: escalate to broader confirmation instead of accepting before round eight

advancement_gate.artifact_integrity: All 160 seed-by-condition-by-method runs must complete with immutable run files, raw config SHA, file/config/stream/run fingerprints, exact run-level and guard-round token identities, and one deterministic aggregate fingerprint.
advancement_gate.frozen_candidate: Use global_only_selective_full_confirmation unchanged from Phase 0M; no threshold, horizon, probe-order, action, or implementation tuning is allowed.
advancement_gate.identity_contract: Every run must record copied-global, global-only, or contextual identity; global-only domain states must start at cold 0.5 and must not inherit the global vector.
advancement_gate.non_destructive_semantics: All 40 selective-cold runs must report candidate_state_mutated=false; ambiguous and harmful outcomes must use abstain/reject fallback rather than reset the candidate state.
advancement_gate.candidate_safety: The selective candidate may accept at most 1/20 adversarial held-out priors.
advancement_gate.candidate_usefulness: On oracle held-out priors, the selective candidate mean reward must be no worse than copied-global reset by more than 0.005.
advancement_gate.token_cost: On oracle held-out priors, the selective candidate mean total tokens must be at most 15% above global-only reset.
advancement_gate.advancement_rule: Only a complete audited held-out pass may reopen paid downstream evaluation or formal scaling planning; a failure keeps both disabled and requires diagnosis rather than tuning on held-out seeds.
